def factor_cycle_range_pressure(df):
    """Buyer/seller pressure within the trailing range indicates the cyclical phase."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    buy_pressure = (df_copy["close"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    df_copy["factor_cycle_range_pressure"] = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_range_pressure"]
description: Measures the accumulation/distribution pressure within a stock's own 60-day high-low range. When closes consistently sit near the upper end of the range, buy-side pressure dominates and the stock is in an upward cyclical phase; closes near the lower end signal distribution and a downward phase. This range-pressure ratio captures the internal cyclical structure of price action and is distinct from trend-following or volatility-based indicators.
